description: "Micrographia" by Robert Hooke is a scientific book published in 1665.
longDescription: The first major publication of the Royal Society, it reveals a hidden world through microscopic observation, featuring spectacular illustrations of insects and plants magnified for the first time.

authorInfo.bio:
Robert Hooke (1635–1703) wrote Micrographia
Some Physiological Descriptions of Minute Bodies Made by Magnifying Glasses with Observations and Inquiries Thereupon. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
